## What changes and why

## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Only `CHEATSHEET.md` changed for content, and `npm run build` was run after it
- [ ] A new version and its `CHANGELOG.md` entry (`npm run bump <version>`): merging this publishes it as a release
- [ ] Every new command was run on a real host, and a command that changes state says so
